purpose: Canonical registry for validated part-specific orientation overrides. This file stores transform exceptions once so generators do not duplicate or rediscover them.
scope_rule: Use an override whenever the ObjectID appears in a placement-sensitive role. Do not generalize an override to nearby parts unless separately validated by JSON/export and screenshots.

native_geometry_evidence.interpretation: Thin local-Y depth with wide/tall sign plane. It is already a vertical sign plane in the tested JSON->Python/Builder path.

BILLBOARD.failure_if_ignored: Generic rx=90 rotates the sign into a perpendicular shelf/projection instead of a flush vertical billboard.
validated_by: JSON-mapping principle: compare Python intent to exported serialized transforms
